operations.name: Joseph J. Gordon

expected.name: Joseph J. Gordon
expected.description: Joseph J. Gordon was from Chicago, Illinois. Joseph J. Gordon was convicted at the mass IWW trial in Chicago, sentenced to ten years in prison and fined $30,000. He served in the Cook County Jail and Leavenworth Penitentiary from September 7, 1918, to May 5, 1919, and from April 1921 to May 22, 1922.

operations.research_note: National Archives official Leavenworth inmate index explicitly lists JosephJ.Gordon as13122. Contemporary IWW prisoner mugshot reproduction independently identifies the same name and number. Added historical Leavenworth register, not a modern BOP locator number; existing admission/release and biography preserved. Additional1921-1922custody requires separate verification.
